title: Hjalmar Schacht advises Sukarno on a revolutionary fund

tellings.quote: He had met Sucarno. He had been denosified, shocked, and had wound up in Indonesia visiting Sukarno saying you have to build an Islamic crescent to defend against Chinese communism, right?

plain: Peter Levenda, an author who writes about secret history and the occult, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that Hjalmar Schacht, a German financier from the Nazi era, went to Indonesia after the war. Levenda says Schacht had been through denazification, the Allied process of clearing former Nazis, and then visited Sukarno, Indonesia's leader. According to Levenda, Schacht told Sukarno to build an "Islamic crescent" of nations to hold back Chinese communism, a story told to suggest that old Nazi networks went on shaping world politics after the war.
